Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. Start at ewd: the pair (ewd, tjt) comes first; its second item is tjt, so the next pair is the one whose first item is tjt: (tjt, ahj). Its second item is ahj, but ahj never appears as a first item - so ahj is the dangling end of the chain.
